
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the November 28, 2001/Agrahayana 7,  1923 (Saka)

(Ministries: Coal and Mines; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy
Sources; Power; Rural Developmnet; Textiles)
Total number of questions20

WIN2\SESSION\3450rs 1
Design flams in MIG fighter planes
*141. SHRI KRISHNA KUMAR
BIRLA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the former Indian Air Force
Chiefs have revealed that MIG fighter planes
have design flaws as reported in the
Hindustan Times dated the 22nd August,
20001;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government to
such views of the former Indian Air Force
Chiefs;
(c) whether Govenment have been
purchasing new MIG fighter planes from
Russia inspite of design flaws; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Rally by Indian Ex-services League of
Sangrur district
*142. SHRI C.M. IBRAHIM: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Sangrur district unit of
the Indian Ex-services League held a rally
in local war Heroes Stadium on Septmber
17, 2001, to press their demand for one
rank, one pension, and other demands;
(b) if so, what are their demands; and
(c) what is Government’s response and
reaction thereto?
Providing drinking water from
tubewells in Orissa
*143. SHRI MANMOHAN SAMAL:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Govenment have any plan
to provide drinking water through tubewells
in the State of Orissa;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what steps have been taken by
Govenment to provide drinking water inthe
Western Orissa region?
Advance deposit for supply of coal to
power plants
*144. SHRI P.N. SIVA: Will the Minister
of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the criteria and conditions for the
supply of coal to power plants;
(b) whether Government have asked
purchasers of coal from the power palnts to

2
WIN2\SESSION\3450rs 2
deposit in advance an amount equivalent to
one month’s purchase of coal; and
(c) if so, whether the power plants have
refused to deposit any money as advance?
Deployment of forces in Tripura
*145. SHRI KHAGEN DAS: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to
state:
(a) what is the current deployment of
forces in Tripura;
(b) whether the forces are adequate for
counter-insurgency operation as well as
manning the long international Indo-
Bangladesh border; and
(c) how soon the forces as requested by
the State Government are likely to be
deployedin Tripura?
New definition to the electrification of a
village
*146. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a new definition
is being given to the electrification of a village;
(b) if so, what is the new definition;
(c) state-wise details the level of rural
electrification according to the new definition;
and
(d) the action plan toachieve the total rural
electrification and the amount allocated, state-
wise?
Collaboration of India and Pakistan in
Textiles sector
*147. SHRI R. SARATH KUMAR:
SHRI P.N. SIVA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether India and Pakistan have
decided to collaborate to protect their
interests in the textilies sector against
European Union;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the mechanism evolved to protect
the interests of textile manufacturers?
Nexus of organised crime with
antinational forces
*148. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Union Government have
expressed concern over emerging nexus
of organised crime with anti-national
forces including militant and
fundamentalist organisations;
(b) if so, whether Union Govenment
have taken any concrete steps to break
such nexus; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Private investment in mines and
minerals sector
*149. SHRI GAYA SINGH:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to encourage Private
investment inthe mines and minerals
sector;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal in
this regard;
(c) whether Government have received
any proposal from private parties for
investmnet in mines and minerals sector;
and

(d) if so, the details thereof?
Creation of Central Law Enforcement
Agency (CLEA)
*150. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal is
a foot to create a Central Law Enforcement
Agency (CLEA) in the near future;
(b) if so, the details thereof including the
composition, functions and the tenure of
the CLEA;
(c) whether the viewpoints of the
different political parties and the various
State Government have been elicited with
regard to this proposal and if not, the reasons
therefor; and
(d) by when the agency is likely to be
put in place?
Funds for Pradhan Mantri Gram
Sadak Yojna in Kerala

RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

WIN2\SESSION\3499RS
1
Setting up of Regulatory Authority
for coal
1059. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGAR RAM
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to set-up a Regulatory authority for coal
mining in the country;
(b) if so, the salient features of the
authority; and
(c) the present status of the proposal and
whether Government propose to invite
foreign companies to invest in India for coal
mining and if so, the details thereof?
Restructuring Coal India Ltd.
1060. SHRI GAYA SINGH:
SHRI NAGENDRA NATH
OJHA:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
restructure Coal India Ltd.; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Availability of chromite in the country
1061. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) the areas where Chromite is available
in the country;
(b) the steps taken for harnessing the
Chromite resources on commercial lines
during the last three years; and
(c) the revenue collected by Government
from the same during the said period?
Exploration of diamonds in Hirakud
area of Orissa
1062. SHRI SANTOSH BARGODIA:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the ancient
diamonds mines are existing in Hirakud area
of Orissa and whether Government have
carried out necessary survey in this regard;
(b) whether government has explored
the possibility for commercial mining in the
area; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
GSI surveys of discover precious
metals in Andhra Pradesh
1063. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the surveys conducted
by the Geological Survey of India (GSI) to
discover diamonds, gold P.G.E. and other
precious metals in Andhra Pradesh;

2
WIN2\SESSION\3499RS 2
(b) the districts which have been found
to have the reserves of these metals;
(c) the estimated quantity of the deposits
of the metals in various districts; and
(d) the efforts being made to extract these
metals?
FDI proposals in coal and mining
sector
1064. SHRI ANANTA SETHI: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a large number of Foreign
Direct Investment proposals are under the
consideration of the Government in the coal
and mining sectors;
(b) if so, what are those proposals;
(c) the State-wise details thereof;
(d) at what stages these projects are
pending; and
(e) the details thereof?
Lignite mining at Neyveli
1065. SHRI S. NIRAIKULATHAN:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of lignite mined at
Neyveli in Tamil Nadu each year;
(b) the annual royalty payable to the
Government of Tamil Nadu by the Centre;
(c) the balance of royalty on account of
lignite mining due to be paid to Tamil Nadu;
and
(d) by when this is likely to be paid?
Allocation of Coal to Gujarat State
Electricity Board from Kerala Rewa
1066. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Coal Linkage Committee
has considered the proposal of Gujarat
Electricity Board to restore allocation of 50
percent coal from Korea Rewa instead of
31.3 percent;
(b) if not whether the item of Coal
Linkage to GEB was put on the agenda of
the Committee, meeting every quarter; and
(c) what is the financial implication if
the GEB’s proposal is accepted by Coal
Linkage Committee, both to the Ministry of
Coal and to the GEB?
Abolition/lowering of customs duty on
aluminium
1067. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Hindalco and Nalco are
amongst the lowest cost producers of
aluminium in the world;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Customs
Duty on Import of Aluminium in India, at
25% basic and 30.8 percent effective, is
much higher than prevailing duty in ours
neighbouring developing countries because
of which primary producers in India have
deliberately kept their selling prices much
higher than international price prevailing at
London Metal Exchange; and
(c) if so, the reasons the Ministry of
Coal and Mines is not recommending to
Finance Ministry for abolition/lowering of
customs duty on aluminium to save
secondary industry?

be pleased to state:

General Managers and Directors have been
